method: Re-fetch only prior detected catalog roots over bounded anonymous HTTPS, validate and pin public DNS, no redirects, no scripts executed, no external requests or credentials.
limitations: Only static shape is compared. Replacing quoted strings and numbers can group different behavior; shared shape or network identity does not establish origin, operator, malware or safe content. AMSI provider may use cloud features.

literal_navigation.limitation: Only direct unescaped quoted assignments and assign/replace calls in scanned script prefixes; concatenated or computed values remain unconfirmed and no target is requested.

static_atob.limitation: Only direct quoted base64 arguments in selected script prefixes are decoded; no variables, concatenation, escapes, code execution or network requests.
